# Suede AI Skills

> Suede AI Skills gives founders, marketers, and small teams reusable workflows for SEO audits, AI search visibility, conversion copy, and business operations. Run them in Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, with instructions you can inspect and adapt to your business. Start with a page or business brief to get prioritized audit findings, positioning and campaign plans, or a map of operational bottlenecks. The pack also includes code review, app delivery, and creator-rights tools. Original work is MIT licensed; adapted components retain their upstream notices. Every skill is a plain Markdown SKILL.md folder. Read the skill-specific inputs, outputs, and scope before running it.

Maintained by Jason Colapietro (Suede AI, https://suedeai.ai), one author. These are the same skill folders that run the estate day to day, published as they are: open the folder and read the file before you trust it. Repository: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills. License and attribution details: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills/blob/main/NOTICE.md. The GitHub Pages site is generated from the same repo, so the docs, the install commands, and the MCP source sit beside the skills they describe. October 2026: Suede AI is a member of Claude for Startups, Anthropic's startup program (https://claude.com/programs/startups).

Install for Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills` then `/plugin install suede-skills@suede`. Two commands, about thirty seconds. Focused subsets exist for narrower work, and they cost the same per skill because an unmatched skill never loads its body: `suede-marketing@suede` (40 skills for paid acquisition, outbound, pricing, offers, lifecycle, social growth, AI search optimization, attribution, and analytics), `suede-agent-workflows@suede` (orchestration, workflows, evals), and `suede-code@suede` (review, grade, ship-gate).

Install the full pack for Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills --ref main` then `codex plugin add suede-skills@suede-codex`. The plugin registers 1 read-only MCP server with 9 tools. For one skill only, use the built-in skill installer with `--repo JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills --path skills/<name>`.

Install from PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/suede-creator-skills/. With pipx installed, run `pipx install suede-creator-skills` then `suede-skills install` for Claude Code, or `suede-skills install --target codex` for Codex. The Python CLI requires Python 3.9 or newer and has no runtime dependencies. Existing skill folders are preserved unless `--force` is used. Python installation and upgrade instructions: https://skills.suedeai.ai/plugins.html.

Install on Hermes Agent (Nous Research): the repository is a skills tap. `hermes skills tap add JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills` subscribes to all of it; `hermes skills install JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills/skills/<name>` takes one skill without subscribing. Hermes downloads the whole skill folder, scans it, and exposes it as a `/skill-name` command. The MCP server and the executable Suede AI Thought Graph workflow do not travel to Hermes; the skill contracts do.

Runner boundary for Suede AI Graph Flo XR: the bundled Suede AI Thought Graph workflow runs on Claude Code for macOS and nowhere else. It needs six registered `suede-graph-flo-xr-*` agent profiles, which the full Claude Code plugin, the `suede-agent-workflows` subset, and `install.sh` register for you. Codex, generic skills-CLI, and single-folder installs load the orchestration contract but do not execute the bundled Claude Workflow unless those six profiles are installed separately in Claude Code.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://skills.suedeai.ai/): The landing page. Two commands to install, the whole catalog, the FAQ, and the proof links behind each claim.
- [Full guide](https://skills.suedeai.ai/guide.html): The chain end to end. Plan the change, build it in lanes, grade the diff A to F where the weakest lane caps the grade, strip the slop out of the copy, then ship. Also covers the MCP server, install paths, and the FAQ; the complete list is on the skill index above.
- [Skill index](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/): Browse every skill.
- [Agent Skills Directory](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/): A curated index of 3,868 public Agent Skills (97% under an open-source or open-content license) from 161 other GitHub repositories, in 16 category directories. Every listing links to the author's repository, passes the Suede Skill Check's structural listing gate, shows a 0–99 quality score and letter grade, and states its license; the 1,765 skills scoring 80–99 offer numeric and letter README badges (either valid linked badge can qualify for verified promotion); security scan status is separately marked not scanned; full skill pages summarize the scripts, credentials and network calls found in the skill's files; [how skills are listed](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/methodology/). Edited by Jason Colapietro, Suede AI. Category directories:
  - [AI Agent and LLM Engineering Skills for Claude and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/ai-agents-llm/): 604 listed AI agent skills.
  - [Developer Tool and Framework Skills for Claude and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/developer-tools/): 545 listed developer tools skills.
  - [Marketing and SEO Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/marketing-seo/): 339 listed marketing and SEO skills.
  - [Product Management Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/product-management/): 239 listed product management skills.
  - [Science and Research Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/science-research/): 210 listed science and research skills.
  - [DevOps and Cloud Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/devops-cloud/): 360 listed DevOps and cloud skills.
  - [Video, Image and Audio Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/media-creative/): 235 listed video, image and audio skills.
  - [Productivity and Knowledge Work Skills for Claude and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/productivity-knowledge/): 216 listed productivity skills.
  - [Business, Sales and Finance Skills for Claude and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/business-finance/): 169 listed business and finance skills.
  - [Testing and QA Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/testing-qa/): 192 listed testing and QA skills.
  - [Data, Analytics and Database Skills for Claude and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/data-databases/): 180 listed data and database skills.
  - [Security Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/security/): 115 listed security skills.
  - [Frontend and Design Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/frontend-design/): 199 listed frontend and design skills.
  - [Writing and Editing Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/writing-content/): 116 listed writing and editing skills.
  - [Code Review and Code Quality Skills for Claude and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/code-review-quality/): 94 listed code review skills.
  - [Document and Office File Skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/documents-office/): 55 listed document and office file skills.
- [Agent skills guides](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/guides/): Guides by Jason Colapietro, Suede AI, built on the directory's published data:
  - [Best SEO, AEO and GEO skills for Claude Code and Codex](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/guides/best-seo-skills/): The highest-scoring SEO skills for Claude Code and Codex, by job: audits, schema, AI search (AEO and GEO), keywords, local and programmatic SEO.
  - [How to install agent skills in Claude Code, Codex and Cursor](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/guides/install-agent-skills/): Where Claude Code and Codex load skills, how to install from GitHub with one command, how plugin marketplaces work, and what to check before you install.
  - [Agent skills vs MCP servers vs plugins: which one do you need?](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/guides/skills-vs-mcp-servers/): A skill adds method, an MCP server adds access, a plugin packages both. When to use each, how they combine, and what each costs in context and risk.
  - [How to get your agent skill found in search and cited by AI assistants](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/guides/skill-ai-visibility/): How skill publishers get picked by agents, found in search and cited by AI assistants: descriptions that trigger, READMEs that answer, listings and badges.
- [Skill AI-visibility check](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/check/): A free, in-browser check for skill publishers that shows a listed skill's 0–99 score by component and its largest open points. It sends nothing to Suede AI.
- [Installs and MCP](https://skills.suedeai.ai/plugins.html): Install commands for Claude Code and Codex, plus the optional Suede AI Skills MCP server.
- [Listings](https://skills.suedeai.ai/listings.html): Every third-party directory, registry and curated list that carries the pack, including skills.sh, SkillsMP, the official MCP Registry, npm and MCP Market, with each link verified on the date shown.
- [Copy bank](https://skills.suedeai.ai/copy.html): Public-safe explainer copy and reusable launch language.
- [Cracked devs only](https://skills.suedeai.ai/cracked.html): The Agentic Adderall Stack, three skills for the runs that have to finish. Instant release is one continuous subagent-driven pass with adversarial review inside it. Extended release scores the next move and hands it back as a runnable prompt. The plan search caps at 55, 110, or 200 agent calls.
- [S-Tier, the book](https://skills.suedeai.ai/book/): A free book, roughly 29,900 words in 14 chapters, on how Agent Skills work and how a builder gets good with them. Every claim in it points at a file in this repo, so you can check it instead of believing it. Covers progressive disclosure and description routing, outcome-bound orchestration, agent lanes and worker fleets, verification discipline, code grading, design and copy as systems, distribution, shipping, a five-tier builder ladder, authoring your own skills, and a ninety-day practice plan. Source Markdown: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills/tree/main/book. Print edition (PDF): https://skills.suedeai.ai/book/s-tier.pdf

## Workflow skills: from planning a change to grading whether it ships

- [Suede AI Workflow Skills](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-workflow-skills.html): Umbrella router that loads the full Suede AI pack from one install path, picks the specialist for each request, and hands back one scored next move as a runnable prompt.
- [Suede AI Agent Teams](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-agent-teams.html): Coordinate complex changes and public-repository contribution programs with collision checks, atomic issue leases, review gates, authority boundaries, and a signed handoff.
- [Suede AI Ops Architecture](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ops-architecture.html): Fix the shape of a system before anyone builds it: entity schema, one write path per entity, every unit of work routed to an automation, an agent, or a human, and each tool marked absorb, keep, or kill with a proof path.
- [Suede AI Ops Assessment](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ops-assessment.html): Map how work actually happens before anyone designs a system: floor-level interviews with the people doing the work, an inventory of every silo, friction quantified in the operation's own numbers, and opportunities ranked by value against build complexity.
- [Suede AI Eval](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ai-eval.html): Design AI evaluation strategy, failure-mode rubrics, test cases, and acceptance gates.
- [Suede AI Code](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-code.html): Review and grade code in one pass: P0-P3 findings with file:line evidence, an A-F ship grade across seven lanes with instant-F triggers, plus findings-only and grade-only modes.
- [Suede AI Graph Flo XR](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-graph-flo-xr.html): Claude Code/macOS Suede AI Thought Graph shipping search: generate competing plans, score and prune, refute and improve survivors, aggregate compatible lanes, then mutate only the selected plan. Light/standard/deep cap at 55/110/200 calls. Production reads only; never deploys. Other supported agents load the contract and route to direct implementation.
- [Suede AI Ship Copy](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ship-copy.html): A separate copy-only DAG: blind research lenses, an audit of every agent-generated claim, one message per section, adversarial review, deslop pass, and a publish-readiness gate. Never audits what the requester supplied.
- [Suede AI CI Gate](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ci-gate.html): Wire any repo so CI actually gates the merge.
- [Suede AI Parity Contract](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-parity-contract.html): One domain implemented on many surfaces, held together by a contract generated from the reference surface's live constants. Followers assert against it, existing divergences are pinned with reasons, and a new one fails a test instead of reaching a user.
- [Suede AI Play Release](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-play-release.html): Google Play delivery where every claim is a readback: credential preflight against the live API, AAB signature and versionCode verification, promote instead of re-upload, staged rollout, and a track read that shows whether the release landed staged or complete.
- [Suede AI Design](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-design.html): Evolve any interface from generic to intentional with design laws and tokens, full redesigns, Suedify reference restyling, and visual QA.
- [Suede AI Copy](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-copy.html): Conversion and SEO copy in one writing lane: headline formulas, persuasion frameworks, brand voice, answer-first copy for AI search, and an anti-slop gate.
- [Suede AI Slop Stop](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-deslop.html): Context-aware anti-slop cleanup or findings-only audit that preserves facts, voice, house style, and intentional phrasing, invents nothing, and never claims to identify authorship.
- [Suede AI SEO Audit](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-seo-audit.html): SEO, AEO, GEO, AI EO, metadata, schema, link, and crawlability audit.
- [Suede AI Visibility Grader](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-visibility-grader.html): Grade any public page for findability, first-screen clarity, CTA pull, proof, and AI citation readiness.
- [Suede AI Site Alchemy](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-site-alchemy.html): Turn a page into a conversion engine with funnel and friction analysis.
- [Suede AI Launch Packaging](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-launch-packaging.html): Ship work as a launch people can actually install.
- [Site to iOS App](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/site-to-ios-app.html): Convert any website or web app into an App Store-ready iOS app plan or shell: URL audit, App Store 4.2 wrapper-risk gate, Capacitor or native-shell strategy, native value requirements, QA matrix, and an explicit release gate.
- [Android App Factory](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/android-app-factory.html): Plan or build a native Android app end to end from a keyword: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose scaffolding, Play Billing, Play Store screenshots and ASO listing copy, Data Safety disclosure, signing, and Google Play Console release.

## Marketing and growth skills, run by the same agent that reviews the code

- [Suede AI A/B Testing](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ab-testing.html): Test so the result means something.
- [Suede AI Ad Creative](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ad-creative.html): Produce ad creative at volume.
- [Suede AI Ads](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ads.html): Run paid acquisition that pays back.
- [Suede AI SEO](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ai-seo.html): Get cited in AI-generated answers on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Claude.
- [Suede AI Analytics](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-analytics.html): Know whether any of it worked.
- [Suede AI ASO](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-aso.html): Optimize an App Store or Play listing.
- [Suede AI Attribution](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-attribution.html): Know which marketing actually drove revenue.
- [Suede AI Churn Prevention](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-churn-prevention.html): Keep subscribers who are leaving and recover the ones you lose to billing.
- [Suede AI Co Marketing](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-co-marketing.html): Find and run partner campaigns.
- [Suede AI Cold Email](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-cold-email.html): Write B2B cold outreach that gets replies.
- [Suede AI Community Marketing](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-community-marketing.html): Build a community that compounds.
- [Suede AI Competitor Profiling](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-competitor-profiling.html): Research competitors from their public surfaces and turn the findings into structured profiles.
- [Suede AI Competitors](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-competitors.html): Write comparison and alternative pages that rank and convert without misrepresenting anyone.
- [Suede AI Content Strategy](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-content-strategy.html): Decide what to publish and why.
- [Suede AI Customer Research](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-customer-research.html): Find out what customers actually think.
- [Suede AI Directory Submissions](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-directory-submissions.html): Work the directory layer deliberately.
- [Suede AI Emails](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-emails.html): Design lifecycle email that runs itself.
- [Suede AI Free Tools](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-free-tools.html): Engineering as marketing.
- [Suede AI Image](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-image.html): Create and optimize marketing imagery.
- [Suede AI Influencer Outreach](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-influencer-outreach.html): Pitch creators with messages they answer.
- [Suede AI Lead Magnets](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-lead-magnets.html): Decide what to give away for an email.
- [Suede AI Marketing Council](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-marketing-council.html): Put one marketing decision to a panel of role-based advisors, map where they disagree, and synthesize a recommendation.
- [Suede AI Marketing Loops](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-marketing-loops.html): Turn marketing into a recurring loop an agent runs on a cadence.
- [Suede AI Marketing Plan](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-marketing-plan.html): Produce a full marketing plan structured by acquisition, activation, retention, referral, and revenue, or a ranked shortlist of tactics when that is all you need.
- [Suede AI Newsroom](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-newsroom.html): Run one idea through a six-role content pipeline.
- [Suede AI Offers](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-offers.html): Construct the thing you actually sell, then apply persuasion mechanics honestly as testable hypotheses.
- [Suede AI Onboarding](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-onboarding.html): Cut friction out of signup and get a new user to first value fast.
- [Suede AI Pricing](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-pricing.html): Decide what to charge and how to package it.
- [Suede AI Product Marketing](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-product-marketing.html): Establish the product context every other marketing lane reads from.
- [Suede AI Programmatic SEO](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-programmatic-seo.html): Build search pages at scale without building junk.
- [Suede AI Prospecting](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-prospecting.html): Build and qualify a target list before you write a word.
- [Suede AI Public Relations](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-public-relations.html): Earn coverage without a retainer.
- [Suede AI Referrals](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-referrals.html): Turn customers into a channel.
- [Suede AI RevOps](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-revops.html): Wire marketing to revenue.
- [Suede AI Sales Enablement](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-sales-enablement.html): Arm the people doing the selling.
- [Suede AI SMS](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-sms.html): Run SMS without getting blocked or resented.
- [Suede AI Social](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-social.html): Run social as a channel rather than a chore, including Instagram account audits, Reels, carousels, and Stories.
- [Suede AI Video](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-video.html): Plan and produce marketing video.

## Creator skills: rights, release folders, and campaigns

- [Suede AI Rights Passport](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-rights-passport.html): Audit ownership, split, sample, and provenance gaps, then package creative folders into structured transfer material with credits and splits.
- [Suede AI Release Linter](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-release-linter.html): Audit release folders for missing metadata, artwork, masters, stems, credits, splits, and provenance gaps.
- [Suede AI Campaign in a Box](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-campaign-in-a-box.html): Turn a song, release, or era into a complete artist campaign.
- [Suede AI Sync Packaging](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-sync-packaging.html): Package songs for sync pitching with scene-fit angles and clean asset checklists.

## MCP server

- Suede AI Skills MCP: Optional Model Context Protocol server for structured skill discovery, install guidance, SEO/AEO/GEO/AI EO audit scaffolds, and QA checklists. 9 tools, 7 resources, 5 prompts, dependency-free stdio. Source: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills/blob/main/mcp/suede-skills-mcp.mjs

## Evidence boundary

Suede AI skills organize work, generate reports, improve public docs, and prepare review material. They do not clear legal rights, publish releases, write to registries, approve payouts, or upload private files unless a separate workflow explicitly does that and the operator approves it.

## Source and citation guide

- [AI Instructions](https://skills.suedeai.ai/ai-instructions/): Site identity, authoritative sources and citation guidance.

## Creator training

Jason Colapietro’s training includes Claude Academy / Anthropic badges in the Claude API, Claude Code, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Claude with Amazon Bedrock and Claude on Google Cloud. His search training includes HubSpot Academy’s AEO Fundamentals and Semrush Academy certificates in AI search, keyword research, on-page SEO, local SEO and digital PR. IBM SkillsBuild covers prompt engineering; Google Skills and Databricks Academy cover generative AI. Seven Microsoft Learn module achievements cover Azure AI Agents, Foundry IQ, Visual Studio Code, Microsoft 365, workflows and Microsoft Agent Framework.
Individual course awards and Microsoft Learn module achievements: https://seo.suedeai.ai/evidence#training-credentials
